claims.statement: NodeViewToggle is a StereoModeToggle-style 80x36 two-segment gallery|node control (kViewTiles / kViewNodes icons, help key nodeViewToggle, setNodeView + onToggle callbacks) inserted LEFT of the preset bar in PluginHeader; the header seeds it from services_.prefs.getBool(UiPrefs::kNodeView, false) at construction.

The view choice persists as a plain UiPrefs key UiPrefs::kNodeView = "t3k.nodeView" (UiPrefs.h:68; stored as "true"/"false" strings, default false = gallery): PluginRoot::onNodeViewToggle writes prefs.setBool(kNodeView, nodeView) and calls main_.chainScreen().setView(nodeView).

ChainScreen grows a third view branch: setView(bool) hides the gallery and shows the node view (and back); the node view has NO DragScroller — ChainScreen::scroller() keeps returning gallery_.scroller() even while the node view is visible; closeDetail() restores whichever view nodeView_ says the user was in.
The node-view ticket added Help keys + entries: nodeViewToggle, nodeView, nodeEmptySlot, node, nodePower, nodeRemove, nodeMode.

The node view is a second, TOGGLEABLE views layer over the same ChainState the gallery draws (ticket ui-block-interface-draft.md): no new DSP — a slot's contents ARE the existing ChainBlocks re-arranged in ChainState lane order, and every mutation goes back through ChainStore so gallery and node view can never disagree. The old 4x3 snake grid (kColumns=4/kRows=3, 84x60 cells, Grid::slotNearest drops) was replaced 2026-10-15 by the signal-line grid.

The grid is ONE row of 10 slots (Row::kSlotCount = 10, Row::kLabelH = 18 label band under each square, NodeModel.h:34-36); a SECOND row of 10 appears only when the lane exceeds 10 blocks (NodeView::paint/resized compute nCells = 10 + (lane.size() > 10 ? 10 : 0)) so lanes of 10 or fewer render a single row. Cell i = lane item i (1:1 left-lane map); tail cells beyond the lane are EMPTY = a valid bypassed pass-through state (the key difference from the gallery, where every tile is an effect).

Persistence: UiPrefs::kNodeView = "t3k.nodeView" (UiPrefs.h:68) is a plain STRING pref "true"/"false" — UiPrefs::getBool accepts only those two spellings, anything else (including JUCE var::toString()'s "1") falls back to the default false. ChainScreen's ctor reads it and calls setView(true) when set; PluginRoot::onNodeViewToggle (fired by the PluginHeader NodeViewToggle, an 80x36 two-segment gallery|node control, help key nodeViewToggle) writes the pref and forwards to chainScreen().setView(nodeView). ChainScreen::setView hides the gallery / shows the node view; the node view has no DragScroller.

Testbed: the node-main scenario (scenarios.json) carries a 3-block left lane (compressor selected, chorus, insert) and seeds "localStorage": {"t3k.nodeView": "true"} so the node view is the visible surface. TWO landmines: (1) the seed value MUST be the string "true" — Host::seedPrefs does prefs.set(name, value.toString()) and a JSON bool becomes "1", which getBool rejects (the signal line stayed invisible for the whole 2026-10-15 capture hunt until this was fixed); (2) UiTestbed --capture <outDir> <scenario> is what writes PNGs (--selftest does not), and --capture auto-iterates all scenarios, so node-main gets a golden with no Main.cpp change.

Cell paint states (the Q-Cortex/Line 6 transparency law): an ACTIVE block paints an opaque theme::kSurface fill with kind-colour border at full alpha and a white icon; a POWER-OFF block paints NO fill with border at 0.35 alpha and a muted icon; an EMPTY slot is invisible EXCEPT on mouse hover or when the whole lane is empty/insert-only (CellState.presetEmpty) — then a dashed border + plus glyph + 'add' label so the user knows where to click.

Repaint invariants (bug found in the 2026-10-15 capture hunt — the line stayed invisible for a whole debug session): setNodeView(bool) (NodeView.cpp:460) and chainChanged() (NodeView.cpp:475) both END WITH repaint(), because refresh() only updates the cell children; the body (signal line segments, In/Out labels, strip) must repaint on first-time activation, on lane row gain/loss, and on selection change or the line silently stays absent until an unrelated invalidate.

Pointer grammar on a node: a short click selects the block (params load into the strip); a 250 ms hold (kHoldMs = 250, NodeView.cpp:59) begins a lane drag; motion before the hold cancels the timer; right-click opens the block menu (power toggle, help key nodePower; remove, help key nodeRemove; plus the palette add-menu over Model::paletteKinds()); DOUBLE-CLICK toggles the block's power (NodeCell::mouseDoubleClick -> NodeView::togglePower -> setBlockParam(id,"enabled",0|1)). Cell hover sets a help text (occupied title, ' (powered off)' suffix when off, 'Empty slot — click to add an effect' for inserts) which drives both the JUCE tooltip and the bottom hint bar via the HintBus HintTracker. Drags use juce::Component::createComponentSnapshot ghosts at full alpha and a suppress-click-until timestamp keeps a drop from firing a stray select.

Grid drag-and-drop (user ruling 2026-10-18): cellDragMove tracks a dragInGrid_ flag from the pointer position vs the grid bounds (rowX_±4, row/row-range ±4) and a g_dropTarget slot (row*10+slot), painting a transparent drop preview on the target cell that disappears when the pointer leaves the grid; cellDragEnd (NodeView.cpp:608) — if the drop lands OUTSIDE the grid (g_dropTarget < 0) it is a no-op: cancelDrag() restores the block to its origin; otherwise the full-lane id list from NodeModel::orderWith(blockId, target) — an erase+insert-at-target splice whose direction is determined by the target slot — is committed through chain.reorderBlocks. Drops commit through the store; a drop back on the origin slot is a no-op permutation.

The convolution node's strip carries an IR preview: pullConvPreview (NodeView.cpp:1005) pulls chain.convPreview(blockId) (envL/envR arrays + length/sampleRate + fade curves, the same pattern as the gallery EffectTile::pullConvPreview) into the strip's KernelPlot (convPlot_, a views/gallery/KernelPlot at 64 px height), and a 'Load IR…' button (loadIr_) calls startConvIrLoader (NodeView.cpp:1033) which launches an async juce::FileChooser (*.wav;*.wave;*.aiff;*.aif) and on OK calls chain.loadConvIr(blockId, file); a g_irLoaderSeq token guard drops stale chooser results (WeakReference<Component> is private in JUCE 9, so the loader is token-guarded instead).

The node grid's read-side model (plugin/ui/views/nodeview/NodeModel.{h,cpp} — a const view over ChainState: kind table with kind colours, paletteKinds, blockAt/indexOf, and orderWith splice) is exercised headlessly by test/src/node_model_tests.cpp (9 tests: kind table, palette, blockAt/indexOf, orderWith permutation invariance, exact-slot move, same-slot no-op, unknown-id untouched, target clamping, empty-square move). DspTests compiles the real plugin/ui/views/nodeview/NodeModel.cpp + plugin/ui/model/ChainState.cpp (with plugin/ui and plugin/ui/views/nodeview on the include path) so these tests run the real model, not a copy; the full UI remains unlinked by the suite.

The signal line (NodeView::paint) draws, per VISIBLE row, 2 px white.withAlpha(0.45f) SEGMENTS with a gap around EVERY occupied cell (active AND power-off): an 'In' stub before the first node, ±5 px gaps around each node, an 'Out' stub to the row's right edge; empty slots between nodes stay clear. The two-row transition is Line 6 stadium style (batch 2, user m02657 — NO snake elbow): row 1's line ends with a 13 px Icon::ArrowRight at the grid's right edge, row 2 starts with a 13 px Icon::ArrowRight at the grid's left edge, both rows flow left→right and row 2 enters its leftmost node. The line is painted before the cells and only when nodeView_ is set (which is the first line of paint — an opaque panel fill before the visibility guard used to cover the inactive gallery view, m03703).

NodeStrip is the selected block's SINGLE-ROW parameter strip docked to the BOTTOM of the view (resized(): stripY = jmax(0, getHeight() - stripH - kStripBottomGap), kStripBottomGap = 16, NodeView.cpp:54; full width stripW = W - 16). 56 px header (kStripHeadH = 56, NodeView.cpp:55): block-kind label in caps over the mode line — batch 2 replaced the click/hold cyclers with CONTEXT MENUS: modeB_ is a juce::TextButton whose onClick calls NodeView::openModeMenu() (delay 4 modes / Compressor 5 / reverb 6, current entry disabled with a leading marker) and typeB_ calls openTypeMenu() (reverb type list, shown only when Reverb::numTypes(mode) > 1); both build a std::vector<ContextMenu::Item> and open it centered over the strip via showStripMenu (widgets/ContextMenu, local-coordinate openAtPoint — NodeStrip has no desktop-coordinate conversion). A hide button (hide_, Icon::X) sits to the LEFT of power_ and is the ONLY strip close: hideStrip() clears the selection; the strip stays open while the mouse is inside (knob turns no longer rebuild-and-close it, user m02657 item 9). Per-knob VALUE readout paints persistently above the knob face from KnobScale::format(knobFromStored(*scale, raw)) with the knob's name below (labelOnTop = true), and each knob gets knob->setValue(knobFromStored(...)) after construction so the face sits at the real value (the Knob ctor clamps to options.min — the batch-2 garbage-value fix; batch 1). Panel: theme::kPanelBg @ 0.55 tinted fill, 10 px radius. Knobs are owned std::vector<Knob*> (created on selection, deleted in clearContent()); onChange writes back through chain.setBlockParam(id, param, knobToStored(...)). Params come from the SHARED paramsFor table in views/gallery/EffectParams.h (tone nodes show only In/Out/Mix trims). Every strip knob is headless-tested by test/src/strip_knob_tests.cpp (7 StripKnob tests, round-trip + finite readout + numeric readouts ≤4 chars).

Tone (NAM/conv) nodes in batch 2 behave like their kind, not like empty slots: NodeCell::paint treats `!s.has || s.insert` as the dashed+plus gap state only (hover_ || presetEmpty), so an occupied insert paints its kind-coloured border and icon; NodeCell::update sets the help text to the block's own title when s.has (falling back to help::Key::nodeEmptySlot for true gaps — the old hardcoded 'Empty slot — click to add an effect' with its em-dash mojibake is gone); Model marks insert rows with cs.insert=true and their label as 'add' only while the gap hint shows. Clicking a tone node SELECTS it (strip shows In/Out/Mix), it does not open the add menu (user m02657 item 6).
